currentParagraphText: “I digress; let’s get back on topic,” he said, leaning forward to get a better look at the Shimmershroud Planeswarper. “Since you passed the test with flying colors, I want to give you a Blessing. If we go purely by performance, I would argue we’re in the territory of warranting a True Blessing, but I don’t really know you well enough to make you my Chosen quite yet, and besides, I already have a Chosen, and it would be horribly impolite to take away her Blessing out of nowhere. Hence, that's why I’ve settled on a Divine Blessing.”
